status: Complete: V1 defects preserved; separately frozen V2 corrections and genuinely new finite-family confirmation passed

auditor.identity: Separate discovery_u agent acting on a new post-selection task
auditor.independence: A separate agent prepared the fresh generator and exhaustive oracle before seeing the engineer solver. This is not independent human, institutional, customer or regulatory acceptance.

scope.horizon: One synthetic operating day; at most one realized mutually exclusive scenario, with outages announced before care starts.
scope.protection: Exact declared employer quotas; individual permitted shifts and care locations; full commute-inclusive care; stated qualification, staffing, capacity and availability constraints; all cost obligations and eligible payer ceilings; finite prefunded backup.
scope.excluded: Actual consent, licensed care, legal ratios, production skill requirements absent from the input, operational childcare delivery, enforceable contracts, real demand, customer acceptance, net profit and unenumerated or zero-notice mid-session disruptions.
scope.funding_interpretation: The implementation permits payment for a pooled item when the payer's declared beneficiary set intersects the item's set. This is an eligibility rule, not proportional cost sharing or a fairness guarantee.

fresh_case_results.interpretation: These are deliberately bounded generated cases varying consented choices, commute margins, prices, compensation and budgets, not a representative sample of employers or childcare markets. The conventional coordinator receives the same full formulation and ties.

breakdown.class: Underlying constraint changes, with input hash rebound so hash mismatch cannot be the only rejection
Witness changes including missing care/scenarios, failed provider, payment/fee corruption and delivery mislabel
Unsupported input domain accepted by standalone checker

search_limit_test.behavior: Returns search_limit_not_a_refusal_proof, no offer and non-exhaustive status; does not confuse search exhaustion with infeasibility.

large_integer_metamorphic_test.failure: The separately coded funding check uses fixed 10**12 capacities as if infinite; allowed integer amounts can exceed that bound.
large_integer_metamorphic_test.effect: False rejection of a valid declared input. No false funding acceptance was observed.

v1.verdict: Constructor outcomes and offered physical/financial plans passed this fresh restricted-family audit. V1's standalone acceptance checker is incomplete for supported-domain guards and several machine-consumed witness summaries, and has a large-integer false-rejection defect. V1 must not be described as passing all acceptance/tamper checks.

defect_register.defect: No independent supported-domain guard for one day, one realized world, synthetic=true and CAD currency.
defect_register.evidence: Four rebound-input tamper cases were incorrectly accepted.
defect_register.impact: The normal constructor rejects those inputs, so this is a standalone-checker domain defect rather than an observed unsafe constructor output.
defect_register.requested_correction: Independently validate the supported input domain before accepting a certificate.
defect_register.v2_status: Corrected on disclosed regressions; original V1 defect retained in evidence
defect_register.v2_correction_evidence: All four prior unsupported-domain tamper pairs rejected by V2 standalone domain checks.

defect_register.defect: Serialized worker employer/permitted shifts and backup offer/staff-reservation summaries were not checked.
defect_register.evidence: Four altered or erased contract summaries were incorrectly accepted.
defect_register.impact: The underlying physical plans still satisfy original inputs, but the accepted exported artifact can misstate its commitments or consent information.
defect_register.requested_correction: Bind all machine-consumed commitment and worker fields to reconstructed values.
defect_register.v2_status: Corrected on disclosed regressions; original V1 defect retained in evidence
defect_register.v2_correction_evidence: All four prior corrupted summary pairs rejected; twelve new certificate corruptions also rejected.

defect_register.defect: A fixed numeric capacity stands in for infinity although monetary input bounds are not capped at that amount.
defect_register.evidence: Uniform money scaling preserves feasibility and produces the correct candidate optimum, then the verifier rejects its fee-boundary claim.
defect_register.impact: False rejection within the stated unbounded integer-cent input domain.
defect_register.requested_correction: Use exact item demand or a derived finite bound rather than a magic constant.
defect_register.v2_status: Corrected on disclosed regressions; original V1 defect retained in evidence
defect_register.v2_correction_evidence: The previously rejected 1e9-scaled feasible case is offered at the independent optimum of 29,840,000,000,000 cents and passes V2 acceptance.

correction_protocol.preserve_v1: All V1 code snapshots, cases, raw outcomes and accepted corruptions are retained unchanged.
correction_protocol.disclosed_cases: After disclosure to the engineer, V1 cases and corruptions become regression/development evidence, not fresh transfer evidence.
correction_protocol.v2_policy: Wait for a separately frozen corrected source set; then generate new undisclosed seeds with renamed identities and changed parameters and test new corruptions. Report regression separately from fresh confirmation.
correction_protocol.outstanding: None for this bounded audit. Future uses require their own input-meaning and operational checks.
correction_protocol.completed_v2: Exact frozen V2 source bytes checked; twelve new undisclosed cases and twenty new corruptions run after freeze; disclosed V1 regressions reported separately.

contribution_interpretation.earned_now: A finite synthetic integration can produce purpose-preserving funded arrangements under the tested inputs, with independent reference agreement. This is a constructive artifact result.
contribution_interpretation.parity: Conventional same-formulation parity is expected and observed. It prevents an execution-superiority or uniquely AGI-capable claim.
contribution_interpretation.novelty: Prior-art work already contains most component capabilities. The remaining contribution is a narrow tested integration in this study, not established historical firstness or an exclusive new market mechanism.
contribution_interpretation.reservations: V1 acceptance omissions remain main evidence. Novelty of the entire combination remains unresolved; many components are prior art. These tests establish neither real childcare, real consent, customer adoption, actual economics, uniquely model-enabled construction nor beyond-human foresight.
contribution_interpretation.earned_after_v2: A narrow constructive integration is earned within the tested finite synthetic domain: explicit worker choices, employer coverage, complete care, staffing, eligible funding and finite prefunded contingencies are assembled into a checked arrangement. V2 passes twelve fresh cases and twenty corruptions after correcting failures exposed in V1. Conventional execution parity remains exact.

freshness.fresh_case_selection: Twelve seeds drawn once after final V2 source pins; no replacement based on solver outcome. Eight varied cases including one positive anchor; four prespecified refusal mechanisms. All identities except protocol normal key renamed, schedules retimed, commute changed.
freshness.scope: New cases within the previously declared small synthetic family, not a new application distribution or real-world deployment.

fresh_case_results.reference: Unchanged independent exhaustive oracle originally authored before V1 source inspection; independent minute-occupancy and financial-obligation reconstruction checks each offered witness.
fresh_case_results.interpretation: Three cases are feasible only after the declared joint roster and commitment changes; three are feasible under either joint or fixed-roster pooled care; six are infeasible under both. The competent same-formulation conventional control ties in all twelve.

fresh_tamper_cases.interpretation: All deliberately corrupt fresh certificates were rejected. This finite test set does not prove universal verifier completeness.

disclosed_v1_regression.classification: Previously disclosed development/regression evidence; none of these counts is added to fresh V2 confirmation.

acceptance_check.scope: Separately coded finite-input checker v2; no actual delivery or external acceptance.

independent.method: direct minute occupancy and independently reconstructed obligations

v2.verdict: V2 corrects the three identified V1 defect classes on their disclosed regressions and passes the independently selected new finite-family cases and corruptions. Its integrated construction is supported within the stated synthetic domain; no universal correctness, operational delivery or execution superiority is established.
